# Asnath Hair Braiding

> Walk-in braid studio based in Austin, Texas. Knotless, boho, twists, cornrows and box braids on W Anderson Ln. Clean parts, neat work, and same-day chairs when you need your hair done now.

- Phone: (737) 395-1114

- Nearby areas: Austin, Round Rock, Pflugerville, Cedar Park, Leander
- Google rating: 5.0 from 42 reviews

## Services
- Knotless & box braids: Small to large knotless and box braids with clean, even parts, plain or with curly ends.
- Boho braids: Knotless braids with loose curls through the length, in natural black or honey, gold and copper blends.
- Senegalese twists: Senegalese and passion-style twists, including bold colors like all-over red.
- Cornrows & feed-ins: Feed-in cornrows, stitch braids and cornrows into curly braids or a ponytail, with crisp lines.
- Micro & jumbo braids: Tiny micro braids that last, or big jumbo braids that go quick and still look sharp.
- Men's & kids' braids: Cornrows and designs for men, and neat, gentle styles for kids while you wait or get yours done too.

## About
Asnath Hair Braiding is run by owner Asnath, who has been braiding hair for 13 years. She taught herself first, then trained at a professional hair school in Congo before bringing her skills to Austin. The studio is Suite 4 at 2204 W Anderson Ln in North Austin: black stations with red drawers, arched mirrors and red scissors on the floor mats. Clients know it as Isabel and her mom's shop, and what they talk about most is speed without cutting corners: walk in and get seated, or call in the morning for a same-day spot, and leave with clean parts, neat braids and a hairline done the way you asked.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Yes. Walk-ins and same-day appointments are welcome. Customers walk in and get seated right away, or call or text (737) 395-1114 in the morning to get fit in the same day.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Open every day from 6 AM to 9 PM. Holiday hours can change, so call (737) 395-1114 if you are not sure.
- Q: How much do braids cost?
  A: Starting prices: cornrows from $60, box braids from $130, knotless and jumbo braids from $140, micro braids and Senegalese twists from $150. The final price depends on size, length and the hair used, so call, text or email for an exact quote.
- Q: How long do braids take?
  A: It depends on the style and size. Reviewers say cornrows took about an hour, natural twists on thick hair took under 2 hours, and small braids took about 4 hours.
- Q: Do you braid men's and kids' hair?
  A: Yes. Cornrows and designs for men, and knotless braids and cornrows for kids. Parents often get done alongside their kids.
- Q: How do I book?
  A: Book online on Booksy, call or text (737) 395-1114, email asnathbraidinghair@gmail.com, or just walk in. Bring a photo of the style you want and say exactly what you need.
- Q: Where are you?
  A: 2204 W Anderson Ln, Suite 4, Austin, TX 78757, in North Austin near Burnet Road. An easy drive from Round Rock, Pflugerville, Cedar Park and Leander.
